governing_principle: Prioritize scientific validity, generalization evidence, and safe refusal over cosmetic metrics or UI development.

gaps.title: Out-of-Sample Spatial Uncertainty Calibration & Coverage
gaps.v3_2_1_limitation: Limitation B: Uncertainty coverage 97.60% is strictly in-sample calibration on N=500 points with k=2.24 fitted to the same stream.
gaps.evidence_gap: Independent out-of-sample coverage on unseen warehouse cameras, distances, and lighting is unverified.
gaps.required_evidence: Strict separation between calibration set (fit k) and frozen evaluation/blind set (evaluate coverage across distance and lighting strata).
gaps.current_implementation: safety_backfire_v3/core/uncertainty_risk_engine.py with fixed k=2.24 across all conditions.
gaps.proposed_v3_3_change: Implement condition-aware uncertainty bounds with frozen calibration/blind split protocol in safety_backfire_v3_3/uncertainty/.
gaps.safety_impact: HIGH (prevents false spatial clearance guarantees in defensive braking)
gaps.risk_of_contaminating_evaluation: HIGH (mitigated by strict pre-lock of k prior to blind ingestion)
gaps.validation_method: Empirical coverage rate evaluation across [0.5-4.0m, 4.0-8.0m, >8.0m] distance strata on independent evaluation clips.

gaps.title: Intervention & Safety Backfire Empirical Evidence Expansion
gaps.v3_2_1_limitation: Limitation C: Safety Backfire detection and risk redistribution demonstrated across only N=2 empirical intervention case studies.
gaps.evidence_gap: Small sample size (N=2) strictly prohibits population-level generalization; backfire logic needs evaluation across diverse physical interventions.
gaps.required_evidence: Multi-scenario intervention registry capturing Pre, Intervention, Post, and Control zones across >= 6 distinct intervention topologies.
gaps.current_implementation: safety_backfire_v2/core/intervention.py and redistribution.py with hardcoded 2-case fixtures.
gaps.proposed_v3_3_change: Generalized intervention evaluator in safety_backfire_v3_3/intervention/ supporting speed governors, physical barriers, one-way route reconfigurations, and loading zone redesigns.
gaps.safety_impact: VERY_HIGH (core project mission: detecting secondary risks caused by safety measures)
gaps.validation_method: Two-zone Difference-in-Differences (DiD) and counterfactual analysis across multi-zone intervention datasets.

gaps.title: Physical Video Dataset Expansion & Stratified ODD Lineage
gaps.v3_2_1_limitation: Limitation A: Only 1,672 uncompressed raw frames (64.05s) on disk; 39,900-frame corpus raw source not fully reproducible locally.
gaps.evidence_gap: Warehouse geometry, camera heights (3.5m vs 6.0m), pitch angles, and illumination variations are limited in local physical footage.
gaps.required_evidence: New raw video streams with cryptographic SHA-256 manifests, explicit calibration parameters, and frozen split definitions.
gaps.proposed_v3_3_change: Introduce multi-stream dataset manager in safety_backfire_v3_3/dataset/ with strict DEV, CALIBRATION, VALIDATION, BLIND, and EXTERNAL_STRESS partitions.
gaps.validation_method: Automated dataset split integrity test verifying zero frame/timestamp overlap.

gaps.title: Geometry Degradation & Automated Safe Refusal Engine
gaps.v3_2_1_limitation: Homography relies strictly on flat floor (Zw = 0); non-planar slopes or ramp transitions produce warped projection errors (FAIL-45).
gaps.evidence_gap: System historically lacked runtime non-planarity detection, requiring manual marker exclusions.
gaps.required_evidence: Runtime state machine classifying geometry into PLANAR_VALID, PLANAR_DEGRADED, and NON_PLANAR_REFUSAL.
gaps.current_implementation: Closed-form homography with static distance clamp and manual ramp exclusion.
gaps.proposed_v3_3_change: Safe Refusal Engine in safety_backfire_v3_3/refusal/ gating autonomous control when homography residual error or camera mount pitch exceeds tolerances.
gaps.validation_method: Refusal quality matrix measuring appropriate refusal rate and false refusal rate across ramp/mount-drift stress benchmarks.

gaps.title: Causal DiD Parallel-Trend Verification & Confounder Gating
gaps.v3_2_1_limitation: DiD coefficient -0.4200 is scenario-specific and requires parallel-trend assumption holds across both zones.
gaps.evidence_gap: Automated falsification tests (placebo interventions, pre-period trend stability) are not standardized.
gaps.required_evidence: Pre-treatment trend slope equality tests and simultaneous facility throughput normalization.
gaps.proposed_v3_3_change: Formal DiD causal pipeline in safety_backfire_v3_3/causality/ with explicit placebo tests and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE refusal under trend divergence.
gaps.validation_method: Synthetic and empirical shock simulation testing parallel-trend violation detection.

gaps.title: Multi-Entity Occlusion & Identical Silhouette ReID Survival
gaps.v3_2_1_limitation: Identical high-vis PPE vests cause visual embedding collapse and ID swaps during crossing (FAIL-13 / FAIL-40).
gaps.evidence_gap: Cluster-aware trajectory survival metrics without invalid Wilson CIs have not been benchmarked.
gaps.required_evidence: Spatial Kalman gating combined with temporal trajectory recovery and Hungarian assignment ambiguity score.
gaps.proposed_v3_3_change: Ambiguity-aware tracking filter in safety_backfire_v3_3/tracking/ that marks ambiguous crossing tracks as UNCERTAIN_IDENTITY instead of false swap.
gaps.validation_method: Identity survival and track fragmentation benchmarking on dense interaction replays.
